snippet.title: Tekken 7 - PS4/XB1/PC - Lei (Season Pass 2 Character Trailer)
snippet.description:
Lei Wulong makes his long-awaited return to TEKKEN with the Season Pass 2, this time sporting some new threads, new attitude, and his deadly Tiger, Crane, Leopard, Snake, and Dragon stances! Or will you choose to master his legendary Drunken Master style?
